data.one_liner: Bundle collections of svg, png, and jpg files into a single spritesheet image with generated code.
data.what_it_does: Processes a directory of icon files (SVG, PNG, JPG) to pack them into a single spritesheet image and generates Dart widgets and data classes for easy access. Handles multiple pixel ratios and optional sizing through a CLI tool.
use_when: You want to reduce the number of individual asset files in your project.
You need to bundle mixed SVG, PNG, and JPG icon assets into spritesheets.
avoid_when: You prefer runtime loading of individual asset files without a CLI build step.
You cannot install external CLI dependencies like resvg for SVG rendering.
strengths: Reduces asset count by combining icons into a single spritesheet.
Supports multiple pixel ratios and custom sizing options.
Generates ready-to-use widgets and data access classes.
weaknesses: Requires external tools like resvg installed locally for SVG rendering.
Relies on a separate CLI workflow rather than a build_runner integration.
data.setup_notes: Requires installing the resvg command-line tool and activating the package globally via pub global activate.

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer rendering individual SVG files at runtime without generating spritesheets.
